import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"hack\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("<?hh\nfunction main(): void {}", config)
    println(result)
}
